question: Why does Scaled Dot-Product Attention divide the dot products by the square root of d_k?

question: Compare how Attention Is All You Need and Dynamic Chunking manage sequence length complexity in self-attention.
reference_answer: Attention Is All You Need computes quadratic full pairwise attention (O(n^2)), while Dynamic Chunking reduces quadratic complexity to hierarchical intra-chunk and inter-chunk attention over dynamically formed blocks.
evaluation_criteria: Contrasts standard quadratic O(N^2) Transformer attention with hierarchical dynamic chunk grouping.

question: How does Moshi's streaming audio tokenization compare to the discrete subword tokenization used in the Transformer (Attention Is All You Need)?
reference_answer: The Transformer tokenizes discrete text into subwords (Byte-Pair Encoding / WordPiece), whereas Moshi tokenizes continuous 24kHz audio waveforms into multiple parallel codebook streams using the Mimi RVQ neural codec at 12.5 Hz alongside text tokens.
evaluation_criteria: Explains difference between text subword tokens (BPE) and residual vector quantized audio codebooks (RVQ/Mimi).
